description: Defines trust levels and trust store interface for handling certificate trust in network security, including trust types, trust struct, and trust store methods.

classes.name: CertificateTrust
classes.description: Represents the trust level of a certificate, with methods to create specific trust states and evaluate trust properties.

classes.name: TrustStore
classes.description: Interface for managing and querying trust information about certificates, including trust evaluation and issuer retrieval.

methods.name: CertificateTrust::ForTrustAnchor
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a trust anchor.

methods.name: CertificateTrust::ForTrustAnchorOrLeaf
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a trust anchor or leaf.

methods.name: CertificateTrust::ForTrustedLeaf
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a trusted leaf.

methods.name: CertificateTrust::ForUnspecified
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object with unspecified trust.

methods.name: CertificateTrust::ForDistrusted
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a distrusted certificate.
